limitations: Damage counts enemy unit victims only; structure damage is excluded.
Average military population includes the opening and uses 15-second snapshots.
Production and damage efficiency are matchup/AI observations, not an isolated unit-stat ranking.
Successful skill activation is separate from final effect; nuclear impacts, healing and actual unloads have their own records.
Healers, transports and detectors must not be ranked as weak by direct damage alone.
The reduced odd game counts are not fully side-balanced; completed games were retained when the user reduced the target.
